guide_color-521.note: Standing-height impression and single scene, but four large crown arms replace the two prominent arms. The long arcade annex becomes a boxy house. Surrounding terrain is invented.

guide_color-522.note: Low camera and two crown arms, but the tiered base and arcade are lost. The plain annex and empty ground closely follow the coarse proxy. Surface detail is weak.

guide_clay-521.note: Most convincing illustrated exterior of the guide trials, but not the same architecture: a small gabled cottage replaces the long arcade and the tiered tower base disappears. Sunset and cliff layout are invented.

guide_clay-522.note: Tower and annex remain simplified. A small painted ground patch floats against a flat gray foreground; this reads as an isolated illustration rather than an inhabitable exterior. Do not infer a measured camera height from the output.

qwen_eye-521.note: Retains the important visible crown, faceted base and long arcade. Still an elevated view into the bowl and onto the roof. Wider invented surroundings are not evidence of recovered space.

qwen_eye-522.note: Visible landmark architecture is recognizable, but the eye-level setting leaves the same overhead perspective. Rear platform, small column and vegetation vary from the paired output.

qwen_low-521.note: The low-angle setting still looks down into the crown and onto the annex roof. Similar framing to the eye-level run, not a convincing change of camera elevation.

qwen_low-522.note: Again an expanded overhead illustration, not a standing-height arrival. Crown and arcade remain recognizable, but invented peripheral details vary. Not pixel-identical artwork or persistent geometry.
